name: Living Life
overview: Living life, according to Scripture, involves recognizing God's sovereign guidance over our paths, as Proverbs 16:9 reveals that while we may plan our ways, it is the LORD who directs our steps. The foundation of life itself is established by faith in God's creative word, as Hebrews 11:3 teaches that the visible world was formed from the invisible by God's command. Even from the beginning, as seen in Genesis 3:1, the reality of spiritual opposition reminds believers to trust in God's truth and direction as they seek to live fully under His authority.
